fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at e5f3f751e, fresh go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza to a scratch path, scratch root and repo, rhiza run start --foreground: the cycle-1 failure is fixed. An included gate (outer kind=workflow -> inner gate ig, commands [echo, seq 1 3000 + stderr + exit 5, pwd > file]) failed with detail 'command 2 `...`: exit 5; full output: <run dir>/gate-inner_ig-1-2.log' (3001 lines, stderr kept), the third command ran in the run's worktree; run resume --retry wrote gate-inner_ig-2-2.log beside visit 1's. A top-level failing gate kept gate-g-1-2.log and ran its later command; an all-green included gate passed ('2 commands passed'). run status --json carries the detail. Underscored step names are refused, so safeName cannot collide. Scoped TestGateStep (workflow, run) pass.

QA cycle 2, scratch build, fake rex/claude: included workflow hbi (agent build -> gate check, on.fail = handback:build) under top-level hbo: two gate reds re-entered build (same session ID) and the third pass ended the run done. With handback_cap = 1 on the top-level file the second red parked the run stopped; rhiza inbox showed a handback item naming step hbi/check and the cause with the kept gate log path, and run resume finished green. TestHandbackTarget, TestHandbackRoute, TestInboxHandbackParked pass. Rough edge: handback_cap set only in the included file is accepted by workflow check and ignored.

QA cycle 2, scratch build, fake claude: a red gate step handed back twice; each resume (claude --resume, same session ID) got the handback text 'Fix it, see <session dir>/handback.md', and handback.md named failing step hbi/check, outcome fail and '`gatecheck`: output in <run dir>/gate-hbi_check-<visit>-2.log' for the matching visit. TestHandbackDeliver and TestScripts/run-handback pass.

QA cycle 2, scratch build, fake rex/claude: an agent step's session ran rhiza run spawn --role builder --brief <file> --model sonnet: the child started in the run's worktree, its spawn/<session>/brief.md ends with the contract section then '## Brief / do the child thing', and spawn printed 'Spawned builder session ... under step cond ...: pass (exit 0)'; a child exiting 1 gave 'fail (exit 1)' and spawn exit 1. A missing --brief exits 2 naming the path; outside a run it refuses naming RHIZA_RUN. TestRunSpawn and TestScripts/run-spawn pass.

QA cycle 2, scratch build: rhiza run status listed '## Spawned sessions - cond, builder, model sonnet, session <id>: ended, pass' (and 'ended, fail (exit 1)' for a failed child); --json has spawned[] with step, parent, role, model, state, outcome, detail and session; rhiza session show accepted the child's session ID. TestRunStatusSpawned, TestSpawnedSessionOpenResume and TestRunDetailSpawned pass.

QA cycle 2: not killed by hand (code unchanged since cycle 1's QA); go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/run -run TestSpawnResume passes (driver killed with a live child and a pending hand-back, reattach, recorded once, delivered once).
